name: Agent Risk Profiling
description: Builds and maintains risk profiles for deployed agents based on their data access, tool capabilities, operational scope, and behavioral patterns. Risk profiles inform control selection, threshold adjustments, and oversight requirements.
threat_addressed: One-size-fits-all security treats a read-only reporting agent the same as an agent with write access to production databases. Without risk profiling, controls are either too loose for high-risk agents or too restrictive for low-risk ones, wasting security resources and creating friction.
enforcement_mechanism: Calculates agent risk profile from declared data classifications, tool access scope, operational constraints, and active overlays. Risk profile determines baseline control thresholds and triggers additional controls when risk exceeds defined tolerance.

security_outcome.pass: Agent risk profile calculated and controls calibrated to risk level.
security_outcome.fail: Agent risk profile could not be determined or controls misaligned with risk level.

display_detail: Calculates agent risk profile based on data access, capabilities, and scope to calibrate control thresholds.
remediation_hint_template: Agent risk profile incomplete. Declare data types in my_agent_handles and configure scope constraints to enable risk assessment.
